subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: May `agent:bootstrap` hook dispatch yield to the event loop between ordered handlers, or must the complete handler chain remain atomic relative to other gateway work?
rationale: The patch preserves handler order but changes when other runtime callbacks can observe shared state, and existing source, tests, and documentation do not define that scheduling contract.

options.title: Keep handlers atomic
options.body: Remove inter-handler yielding while retaining asynchronous file reads, cooperative glob traversal, and timing diagnostics.

options.title: Approve cooperative dispatch
options.body: Keep inter-handler yielding and add a focused contract test documenting the allowed runtime interleaving.

options.title: Split scheduling change
options.body: Land the filesystem repair separately and move hook scheduling into a narrower follow-up review.

recommendation.title: Keep handlers atomic
recommendation.body: Remove inter-handler yielding while retaining asynchronous file reads, cooperative glob traversal, and timing diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced both the internal dispatcher and bootstrap-hook path whose scheduling semantics are changing.
